text: On the copper K4 begins near the end of a line, after K3 and a question mark, then fills three lines of 31. A message written into that real shape along some path would be carved in a different order.

Every path along rows, columns, diagonals and spirals, from each corner, straight or back and forth, over K4's lines, the lower plate and the whole left side; each undone, then a repeating key of 1-26 on the sculpture's tables, before or after; 15 scrambled copies.
The shortest key that fits K4 is 23 after the path and 26 before, as on the copies (22 and 26), and K4 leads them nowhere. F4.1 closed for paths over the layout.
